_note: Phase 3.2-RD representation matrix. Written and committed BEFORE any Phase 3.2-RD test-set result was produced or inspected. Do not edit after evaluation to add, drop, or retune a representation. Companion to docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_3_2_REPORT.md.
objective: Test whether the real-data failure-risk signal established in Phase 3.1-RD is robust to a small set of pre-registered feature-representation choices, holding the supervised-learning mechanism (LogisticRegression, same hyperparameters as Phase 3.1-RD's Candidate F) fixed throughout -- consistent with the original Phase 3.2C finding that supervision, not representation, was the operative mechanism. This is a robustness check, not a search for the best-performing representation.

fixed_across_all_representations._classifier_note: Identical to Phase 3.1-RD's Candidate F. Only the feature representation varies between R0/R1/R2 -- the learning mechanism is held constant by design.
fixed_across_all_representations.datasets: identical to Phase 3.1-RD -- same sampled records, same splits, same LOEO structure

R0_raw_scaled.description: Reference representation -- identical to Phase 3.1-RD's Candidate F. Numeric columns: median-impute + StandardScaler. Categorical columns: constant-impute + one-hot. No transformation beyond standardization.
R0_raw_scaled.role: anchor / reference point for comparison, not a new candidate

R1_log_transformed.description: Same feature columns as R0, but non-negative, heavy-tailed count/resource fields are log1p-transformed before standardization, to test sensitivity to the known right-skew of resource-request and count fields (plan_cpu/mem/gpu, instance/task counts).
R1_log_transformed._exclusion_rationale: job_start_time / mean_instance_start_time (Alibaba) and mean_value/std_value/min_value/max_value (AIOps) are excluded from log1p: the time fields are coordinates, not skewed counts, so log-transforming them would not be a natural representation choice; the AIOps value statistics can be negative (telemetry deltas), where log1p is undefined without an arbitrary shift, which would not be a leakage-safe, dataset-agnostic transform to pre-register. These columns remain on the R0 (raw, scaled) path within R1.

R2_pca_reduced.description: The numeric feature block (after standardization) is reduced to its first 2 principal components via PCA(n_components=2), fit on the training fold only (train split for Alibaba; the LOEO training fold for AIOps) and applied unchanged to validation/test/held-out data. Categorical one-hot columns are concatenated unchanged alongside the 2 PCA components. n_components=2 is chosen to match the PCA(2) representation used throughout the original (synthetic) Phase 2/3 methodology (src/failure_memory), not tuned for real-data performance.
R2_pca_reduced.fit_boundary: PCA is refit inside each evaluation context's own training data only -- train split (Alibaba) or LOEO training fold (AIOps) -- never on validation or test data.

explicitly_not_included.additional_representations: None. The matrix is deliberately limited to 3 candidates (1 reference + 2 variants) and is not expanded after seeing results, regardless of how any candidate performs.
explicitly_not_included.alternative_classifiers: Not evaluated in Phase 3.2-RD -- varying the learning algorithm is a different question (already partially answered by the original Phase 3.2C ablation) and is out of scope for a representation-robustness check.
explicitly_not_included.unavailable_alibaba_tables: pai_group_tag_table, pai_machine_spec -- still unavailable in processed form (unchanged since Phase 3.1-RD); not added.
explicitly_not_included.aiops_business_trace_telemetry: Not added -- Phase 3.1-RD's platform-telemetry-only feature source is reused unchanged.
explicitly_not_included.agentrx: No representation experiment is defined for AgentRx. The frozen protocol's hypothesis-dataset mapping (configs/phase3_real_data_protocol.json, hypothesis_dataset_mapping.H2_mechanism_is_supervision_not_representation) already marks both agentrx_magentic and agentrx_tau_retail as NOT_EVALUABLE, decided before Phase 3.1-RD ran. This is unchanged and is not reopened here.

reporting_rule: All three representations (R0, R1, R2) are evaluated on every applicable dataset/split and every result is reported in docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_3_2_REPORT.md, regardless of relative performance. No representation is dropped, hidden, or retained as a 'winner' -- the deliverable is a robustness table, not a selection.
